title: The Power of Authority
summary: Demonstrating the full Authority of the Sovereign Crown, Ha-Jun establishes telepathic control over the 300,000-strong unified demonic armada, marshaling them for the defense of Earth.

panels.shot: mount obsidian grand assembly wide shot
panels.action: The vast 10-mile valley below Mount Obsidian packed with 300,000 unified demon soldiers and 10,000 wyverns.

panels.shot: ha-jun standing on the highest summit ledge
panels.action: Ha-Jun stands at the apex of Mount Obsidian, the Crown of the Sovereign radiating ten concentric rings of light.

panels.shot: tae-jun standing as high general at his right side
panels.action: Tae-Jun wears black-and-gold enchanted general's plate armor, his twin swords sheathed at his hips.

panels.shot: demon king malgath standing at his left side
panels.action: Lord Malgath stands with a newly forged obsidian war hammer, his eyes glowing with fierce loyalty.

panels.shot: ha-jun raising right hand to activate telepathic crown link
panels.action: Ha-Jun touches the central ruby of the Crown; a subtle hum resonates into three hundred thousand minds.

dialogue.text:
[SOVEREIGN DOMAIN: TELEPATHIC NETWORK LINKED]
Connected Minds: 310,482 Units
Signal Fidelity: 100% (No Latency).

panels.shot: three hundred thousand demon soldiers freezing in unison
panels.action: Every single soldier across the ten-mile valley halts their movement, feeling their King's direct heartbeat.

panels.shot: ha-jun voice echoing inside every soldier's mind
panels.action: Ha-Jun's calm, resolute voice speaks directly inside their souls without shouting.

dialogue.text: "Soldiers of the Abyss. Seven thousand years ago, the Void divided us. Today, we stand united as one blood."

panels.shot: soldiers looking up with inspired reverence
panels.action: Demonic warriors of all tribes—iron juggernauts, shadow stalkers, fire fiends—look up with tear-filled eyes.

panels.shot: ha-jun continuing his royal address
panels.action: Ha-Jun continues: 'The Void Primordial has opened gates upon the human world. They think we are divided beasts.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Humein unhe dikhana hai ki Demon Realm ka True Sovereign laut chuka hai!

panels.shot: soldiers raising weapons in thunderous unison
panels.action: Three hundred thousand halberds, spears, and axes shoot skyward with a roar that shakes the twin moons.

panels.shot: ha-jun commanding the first legion to enter the gate
panels.action: Ha-Jun gestures toward the 100-meter golden-violet portal tearing across the sky.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: General Malgath! Lead the Vanguard through the Seoul Gate!

panels.shot: malgath saluting with hammer over chest
panels.action: Malgath slams his hammer against his breastplate: 'By your command, Sovereign!'

panels.shot: malgath leaping off cliff onto his giant war wyvern
panels.action: Malgath dives off the 15,000-foot cliff, landing squarely in the saddle of his 40-foot armored wyvern.

panels.shot: first wave of 50,000 iron juggernauts marching into portal
panels.action: Disciplined phalanxes of iron demon infantry march into the swirling golden portal in perfect formation.

panels.shot: tae-jun turning to ha-jun with calm determination
panels.action: Tae-Jun smiles: 'Main Tokyo Gate sambhalunga, Ha-Jun. Min-Jae ne kaha wahan situation critical hai.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Tokyo Gate par Void Bio-Beasts breach kar rahe hain. Main 30,000 soldiers lekar wahan jaata hoon.

panels.shot: ha-jun gripping tae-jun arm firmly
panels.action: Ha-Jun looks into his brother's eyes with deep love: 'Zinda wapas aana, Tae-Jun. Jung jeetne ke baad humein dinner karna hai.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Ghar par momos aur tteokbokki... Sath mein khayenge.

panels.shot: tae-jun laughing warmly with a nod
panels.action: Tae-Jun laughs: 'Treat tumhare taraf se hogi, Your Majesty! I promise!'

panels.shot: tae-jun opening a secondary portal to tokyo with his bone blade
panels.action: Tae-Jun slashes a secondary dimensional rift leading directly to the neon skyline of Tokyo.

panels.shot: tae-jun leaping through tokyo portal with shadow division
panels.action: Tae-Jun leads 30,000 shadow wraiths through the rift, vanishing toward Japan.

panels.shot: ha-jun remaining alone on summit with kuro
panels.action: Only Ha-Jun and Kuro remain at the peak, wind howling through the star-matter colonnades.

panels.shot: kuro perching gently on ha-jun shoulder
panels.action: Kuro nuzzles Ha-Jun's cheek: 'Ready, Ha-Jun? Seoul awaits its true protector.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Mortal world ko unka Hero wapas milne wala hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun drawing eclipse devourer across his front
panels.action: Ha-Jun holds the dark-matter greatsword with both hands, eyes burning with quiet, immovable purpose.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Main pehle darpok student tha... Ab main un sabki dhaal banoonga jinki koi dhaal nahi hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun spreading his 12-foot shadow wings
panels.action: Ha-Jun's wings unfurl with blinding majesty, feathers glistening with starlight.

panels.shot: ha-jun stepping into the seoul portal
panels.action: Ha-Jun steps forward across the dimensional threshold back toward the human realm.

panels.shot: re-emerging into the stormy night over gangnam station
panels.action: Ha-Jun bursts through the portal into the pouring Seoul rain 500 feet above Gangnam Station.

panels.shot: panoramic view of seoul under apocalyptic siege
panels.action: The city is ablaze: skyscrapers burning, streets swarming with hundreds of thousands of Void Bio-Beasts.

panels.shot: bureau hunters fighting desperately behind energy barricades
panels.action: Captain Baek and Min-Jae firing heavy plasma rifles from behind a failing blue barrier.

dialogue.speaker: captain_baek
dialogue.text: BARRIER INTEGRITY AT 12%! RELOAD! DON'T LET THEM THROUGH!

panels.shot: colossal 50-foot void behemoth raising claw to crush barrier
panels.action: A massive Void Behemoth with six spider legs and acid maw raises a colossal foot over Baek's barricade.

panels.shot: violet lightning bolt striking behemoth from above
panels.action: From the stormy sky, a colossal spear of violet-crimson hellfire spears straight through the behemoth's skull.

panels.shot: ha-jun landing atop the smoking beast corpse
panels.action: Ha-Jun lands with Crown gleaming in the rain, Eclipse Devourer planted in the monster's skull: 'I'm back.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Captain Baek... Min-Jae... Mere shehar se hath hatao, monsters.
